name: Natori Shiroku
source:
Died at the age of 31.

A model prisoner in charge of guarding the Human Realm. He is a former friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c102381]Goemon Ishikawa[/url]'s, and is somewhat an older-brother figure to him.
